welcome_desc:
HLPatcher makes Half-Life and other Valve games
playable on modern ARM Macs that only support
64-bit applications.
welcome_translations_desc: HLPatcher is available in multiple languages! You can help translate it to your language on Crowdin.
welcome_credits_desc: Thanks to Flying with Gauss team, Velaron, Nillerusr and others. Without them, HLPatcher wouldn't exist. Full credits avaiable on HLPatcher's website.
welcome_note_desc: Please be aware that patched multiplayer titles cannot connect to standard PC and VAC-secured servers.
all_patched_desc:
All detected games are already patched!
No further action is required.

If you're experiencing issues, try reinstalling
the game through Steam and running HLPatcher again.
no_games_desc:
No supported GoldSrc or Source engine games were
found in the selected Steam library folder.

Make sure you selected the correct 'common' folder
and that the games are installed.
library_hint:
Select the folder where your GoldSrc and Source games are installed.
If downloaded from Steam, this is the 'common' folder
inside your Steam library directory.
options_mode_latest_desc: Uses the most up-to-date code. May be unstable.
options_mode_stable_desc:
Uses specific versions known to work.
Recommended if "Latest" patching mode fails.
options_backup_desc: Backup will be stored in Documents folder.
failure_help:
Please try patching again using "Stable" patching mode.
If the issue persists, please copy the error details above along with your entire terminal output and create a new issue on the GitHub repository using the button below.
failure_note: Note: GitHub account is required to submit an issue.
success_warning_text:
macOS may block 'SDL2.framework' when launching the game for the first time. SDL2 is a crucial part of the game - it creates the game window and renders its content. Half-Life will not run without it.

If it gets blocked, open System Settings, go to 'Privacy & Security', and look for a message saying SDL2.framework was blocked. Click 'Open Anyway' and confirm.
selection_hint:
Check the games you want to patch.
Already patched games are shown but grayed out.
update_msg:
A new version of HLPatcher is available!

Using an outdated version may lead to broken game installs or compatibility issues with modern macOS versions.
update_skip: You can proceed without updating, but it is not recommended.
